name: Serket
description: A self-sustaining bruiser-summoner who burrows underground to dive the farthest enemy, summons 3 scorpions that inherit her full stats, and converts their deaths into AoE explosions with ATK-Down. Her underground survival mechanic permanently increases her max HP on first threshold, making her tankier the longer a fight lasts.

skills.name: Thousand Sand Shadows
skills.description: Serket burrows underground and summons 3 scorpions around herself. The scorpions inherit 100% of Serket's base stats but take 200% damage, persisting for 10 seconds.

upgrades.level2: Summoned scorpions' duration increased to 15 seconds.
upgrades.level3: Summoned scorpions take 180% damage instead of 200%.
upgrades.level4: Summoned scorpions can also use the Underground Pierce skill.

skills.name: Burrowing Pierce
skills.description: Serket locks onto the farthest enemy, burrows underground and digs a tunnel toward them, dealing 150% ATK damage to enemies along the path. Upon emerging from the ground, knocks down surrounding enemies.

upgrades.level3: Gains a shield equal to 200% ATK upon emerging from the ground.

skills.name: Venomblast Demise
skills.description: When summoned scorpions die or disappear, they explode, dealing 200% ATK damage to enemies within a 3 meter radius and reducing their attack power by 10% for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Burrowing Rebirth
skills.description: While Serket is burrowed underground, she recovers HP equal to 60% of her ATK every second. When Serket's HP first drops below 40% of her max HP, she immediately burrows underground for 3 seconds and permanently increases her max HP by 30%.

upgrades.level2: HP recovered per second while underground increased to 80% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Permanent max HP increase when first burrowing below the threshold increased to 40%.
upgrades.level4: HP recovered per second while underground increased to 100% of ATK.

relic.name: Venomous Domain
relic.description: Serket deals 80% ATK damage to surrounding enemies every second.

upgrades.level2: When receiving damage exceeding 20% of her max HP, she becomes immune to that hit and takes 50% reduced damage for the following 3 seconds. Triggers at most once every 15 seconds.
upgrades.level3: Each summoned scorpion also deals 80% ATK damage to surrounding enemies every second.
upgrades.level4: When each summoned scorpion receives damage exceeding 20% of its max HP, it becomes immune to that hit and takes 50% reduced damage for the following 3 seconds. Triggers at most once every 15 seconds.
